findings.rationale: speculative: early return could strand a caller-owned handle
findings.explanation: When register_cancel_tx returns false, insert bails out before taking ownership of hdl. If a caller elsewhere relied on insert always consuming the handle, the handle would be dropped here instead. No such caller was found in the diff, so confidence is low.

findings.rationale: assert! on cancel_tx replacement panics while holding the lock
findings.explanation: The existing assert!(old_tx.is_none()) fires while state.lock() is held, poisoning the mutex. The comment says that is deliberate, so this is a note rather than a defect.
